user.title: Connect your Spruce account
user.description: Spruce controllers only talk to Spruce's cloud. Sign in with your Spruce account and Home Assistant fetches the account's API key (only the key is kept, not your password), or paste an API key you already have.

menu_options.sign_in: Sign in with my Spruce account

reauth.title: Spruce needs you to sign in again
reauth.description: Spruce no longer accepts the saved key (it changes when the account password changes).

sign_in.title: Sign in to Spruce
sign_in.description: The same username (or email) and password as the Spruce app. They're used once to fetch your account's API key and are not stored.

api_key.title: Enter your Spruce API key
api_key.description: In the Spruce web app (app.spruceirrigation.com) open the browser's developer tools (F12) → Network, click any request to api.spruceirrigation.com and copy the value of its Authorization header. Spruce support can also issue one.

data_description.api_key: Gives full access to your Spruce account; Home Assistant keeps it in its configuration, like other integrations' keys.

error.invalid_auth: Spruce did not accept that key.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Spruce's cloud. Try again shortly.
error.wrong_account: That key is for a different Spruce account.
error.invalid_sign_in: Spruce did not accept that username or password.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different Spruce account from the one this controller belongs to.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Done: Home Assistant now uses the new key.

data_description.default_run_minutes: Used when a zone valve is opened without a run time (each zone also has its own Run time setting).
data_description.status_interval: How often to read which zones are running and the moisture sensors.
data_description.history_interval: How often to read water used, measured flow, settings and the activity log.
data_description.fault_share: A run measuring less than this share of the zone's usual flow is a flow fault (0.2 = 20%).
data_description.review_tolerance: A new flow baseline that moves a zone more than this share from its design flow (or its last accepted baseline) waits for your review (0.25 = 25%).

units.title: Units
units.description: How values are shown. Spruce stores US units; the integration converts. Metric is the default; choose Custom to set each one below.

price.title: Water price
price.description: For the water cost sensors. Price per kL with metric volume, per 1000 gallons with US volume, in your Home Assistant currency.

data.water_price_entity: Or an entity holding the price

data_description.water_price_entity: Used instead of the price above when set (a sensor or input_number).

flow_meter_fault.title: Spruce flow meter may have failed
flow_meter_fault.description: The latest runs of {zones} measured almost no water flow. Usually the flow meter or its wiring has failed (or its model setting is wrong in the Spruce app), so water use is not being counted. Check the meter; this notice clears itself once runs measure flow again.

init.title: Review the new flow baseline

abort.not_loaded: Spruce isn't loaded; try again in a minute.

no_flow_at_baseline.title: Zones measured no flow at the last baseline
no_flow_at_baseline.description: {zones} measured almost no water at Spruce's last flow baseline. The valve may not be opening, a pipe or dripper line may be blocked, or the zone has no heads. Spruce's flow alerts can't work for these zones until it is fixed and a new baseline is run.

flow_calibration.title: Flow meter calibration out of range
flow_calibration.description: The flow meter is set to a custom model with offset {offset}, outside the 0–2 the Spruce app allows. Water figures are probably wrong; check the meter model in the Spruce app (Device Settings → Flow meter).

stale_baseline.title: Flow baseline is over a year old
stale_baseline.description: Spruce's flow baseline is from {date}. Heads, pressure and plants change; run a new baseline (button "Run flow baseline") so flow alerts compare with today's system.

repeaters_silent.title: Zigbee repeaters not reporting
repeaters_silent.description: {outlets} have not reported for over a week. They relay the moisture sensors' signal, so sensors further away go quiet too. Check they are plugged in and switched on; a reset repeater can be paired again with "Pair moisture sensor".

set_hibernate.name: Set hibernate
set_hibernate.description: Turns winter hibernation on or off (no schedules run while on).

until.name: Until
until.description: Schedules resume on this day (leave empty: until switched off).

pair_sensor.name: Pair moisture sensor
pair_sensor.description: Lets a reset Spruce moisture sensor join the controller.

device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

import_history.name: Import water history
import_history.description: Re-imports Spruce's water history into long-term statistics.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

start_date.name: From
start_date.description: First day to import; defaults to when the controller was added.

set_schedule_zone.name: Set a zone in a schedule
set_schedule_zone.description: Changes a zone in a Spruce schedule: how much it waters, whether it is in the schedule, and its rain / freeze / wind skips (per zone in connected schedules). A zone in a zone group changes with its group.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Schedule name (or id) as in the Spruce app.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone name or number, or a zone group name.

enabled.name: In this schedule
enabled.description: Off takes the zone out of the schedule.

rain_skip.name: Rain skip
rain_skip.description: Skip this zone when rain over the threshold is forecast.

freeze_skip.name: Freeze skip
freeze_skip.description: Skip this zone below the freeze temperature.

wind_skip.name: Wind skip
wind_skip.description: Skip this zone above the wind threshold.

pause_schedules.name: Pause schedules
pause_schedules.description: Skips scheduled watering for some days (hibernate with an end date; manual watering still works).

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

run_baseline.name: Run flow baseline
run_baseline.description: Runs every enabled zone for 60 s (plus a 10 s pause) to measure its flow; Spruce applies the new baseline when it finishes and the integration reviews it.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

record_baseline.name: Record a baseline
record_baseline.description: Adds an older flow baseline (e.g. from paper or the Spruce app) to the history.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

flows.name: Flows
flows.description: Flow per zone: zone name or number, then the flow (YAML, e.g. 1: 16.07).

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the flows (default: the integration's flow unit).

review_baseline.name: Review the new baseline
review_baseline.description: Accept the latest baseline for zones waiting for review, or keep their previous values.

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

accept.name: Accept
accept.description: On: use the new values; off: keep the previous ones.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zones (names or numbers); default: all waiting.

set_zone_heads.name: Set zone heads
set_zone_heads.description: Sets the heads installed in a zone (replaces what is there; an empty list removes them).

device_id.name: Controller
device_id.description: Which Spruce controller (needed only if you have several).

heads.name: Heads
heads.description: Rows with model (built-in key, custom:<id>, or brand and model as shown), arc in degrees and quantity (metres for drip line).

user.title: Add a head model
user.description: A sprinkler head, nozzle, dripper or drip line not in the built-in list, or a built-in one with your own figures. Start blank or from a built-in model.

model.title: Head model
model.description: Flow is per {per_360} at a full circle for sprays and rotating nozzles (it scales with the arc you set on a zone), per {per_360} per head for rotors, and per {per_hour} per emitter or per metre for drip. Take it from the maker's chart at your pressure.

data_description.radius_m: For the precipitation rate (sprays, rotating nozzles and rotors).

user.title: Zone heads
user.description: Which zone are you entering the heads for?

data_description.arc: For sprays and rotating nozzles: 90 for a corner, 180 for an edge, 360 for a full circle.

abort.not_loaded: Spruce isn't loaded; try again in a minute.
abort.all_zones_done: Every zone already has its heads; open a zone's entry to change them.
